items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: You studied a long time with him?

ctx.x: Frenchman. The old Frenchman, he died. He died. He died. You studied a long time with him? Huh? You studied a long time?
Yeah, I studied a long time? Yeah. I'm surprised to the world. And then you switched to saxophone later then? Yeah. I had to switch. Yeah. The fellas warned me to switch, so I switched. Yeah.
